newsitem.title: USA: Wash. nuclear unit at 50 pct due to excess hydro.
newsitem.headline: Wash. nuclear unit at 50 pct due to excess hydro.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power plant at Richland, Wash., will run near half capacity through the weekend due to an abundance of cheaper-to-produce hydropower, a plant spokesman said Friday.
The plant had been operating near 68 pct since mid-January because of a recurring problem with an adjustable speed drive, which is expected to be repaired by Thursday, he said.
"(But) the weather has warmed up and it has rained heavily" so Bonneville Power Administration (BPA), which markets the nuclear unit's power output, requested the cutback, the plant spokesman said.
Earlier this week, BPA asked for the plant's annual refueling outage to be extended to 60 days from a previous 42 days, also due to the hydropower surplus.
The refueling was scheduled to begin April 12, but a new date has not been established.
